recommendation: Keep the fix. It aligns the active narrative with the published FHIR-38920 resolution, the 1..1 StructureDefinition cardinality, and the later assignee clarification without separately deciding still-open FHIR-50625.
issue_request: FHIR-38920 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. The request asked for SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.eventNumber to be optional when reliable global sequencing was not needed; the accepted resolution revised the element definition/comment and notification-type guidance instead of adding cross-resource constraints.
initial_application: Commit ac3fb31772962a2b851ae9874dc2600985c7819d applied FHIR-38920 by removing the old sst-1 constraint, updating the eventNumber definition/comment, and adding Event Numbering narrative. It left conflicting notification-type rows saying eventNumber was optional for guaranteed delivery even though the Event Numbering section and StructureDefinition cardinality kept the element required.
additional_context: SubscriptionStatus is active in source/fhir.ini and source/subscriptionstatus/subscriptionstatus-notes.xml is current build source. FHIR-39038 later restored only self-contained SubscriptionStatus constraints and did not make eventNumber conditional on Subscription/channel data. In a Zulip thread linked from FHIR-48808, Gino Canessa clarified that FHIR-38920 allowed a notification-local eventNumber meaning rather than making the element optional. FHIR-50625 later noticed the same inconsistency but remains Triaged.
reconciliation: Updated source/subscriptionstatus/subscriptionstatus-notes.xml so event-notification and query-event rows mark eventNumber as required, handshake/heartbeat rows state it is required when notificationEvent is included, and the Event Numbering introduction refers to globally tracked event numbers.
source_changes: source/subscriptionstatus/subscriptionstatus-notes.xml: clarified that guaranteed delivery removes the need for globally tracked event numbers, not the eventNumber value.
source/subscriptionstatus/subscriptionstatus-notes.xml: changed event-notification and query-event eventNumber rows from conditional optionality to Required.
source/subscriptionstatus/subscriptionstatus-notes.xml: changed handshake and heartbeat eventNumber rows to require eventNumber whenever notificationEvent is included.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue added only self-contained SubscriptionStatus constraints, supporting the choice not to add cross-resource/channel invariants for eventNumber.
Backport IG issue and linked Zulip discussion clarify that R5/R6 eventNumber remains required but may be notification-relative.
Triaged R6 issue flags the same conflicting Event Numbering versus notification-type guidance; it is not final and was not decided separately.
Applied R6 clarification added links from eventNumber/eventsSinceSubscriptionStart definitions to Event Numbering without changing the required-vs-relative semantics.
